```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
```

```{r}
library(geomask)
data(geomask_pts)
radii <- seq(300, 2000, by = 300)
res <- lapply(radii, function(r) {
  m <- mask_donut(geomask_pts, min_r = r * 0.3, max_r = r, seed = 1)
  list(
    r = r,
    k = privacy_k_anonymity(m, r = 500)$k_global,
    risk = privacy_disclosure_risk(geomask_pts, m)$risk_mean,
    lpm = privacy_location_protection(geomask_pts, m, d_min = r * 0.3, r = 500, k_target = 3)$lpm,
    ks = utility_spatial_stats(geomask_pts, m)$nnd$ks_statistic
  )
})
df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(res, as.data.frame))
```

```{r plot, eval=requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df, aes(x = r, y = k)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2166AC") +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "k-anonimato vs radio de masking", x = "max_r (m)", y = "k mínimo (r=500m)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplot(df, aes(x = risk, y = ks)) +
  geom_path(color = "#B2182B") +
  geom_point(aes(color = r)) +
  labs(title = "Curva riesgo-utilidad (KS NND)", x = "Riesgo NN", y = "KS NND") +
  theme_minimal()
```

La **LPM** (*Location Protection Metric*) combina desplazamiento mínimo y k-anonimato local; valores cercanos a 1 indican mejor protección operacional.
